design_overview: A modern, elegant flower delivery app designed with a clean, nature-inspired aesthetic. The interface prioritizes visual product discovery through high-quality flower imagery, intuitive navigation, and seamless checkout flow. The design balances sophistication with approachability, using soft colors, generous whitespace, and clear visual hierarchy to guide users from browsing to purchase completion.

screens.name: Home Screen
screens.purpose: Primary landing screen showcasing featured flowers, categories, and quick access to main features

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background with subtle shadow, contains app logo on left and notification bell icon on right, height 60px
key_components.interaction: Bell icon navigates to notifications, logo returns to top of home

key_components.name: Search Bar
key_components.styling: Light gray background (#F5F5F5), rounded corners (12px), search icon on left, placeholder text 'Search flowers...', height 48px, margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens search screen with keyboard and filter options

key_components.name: Hero Banner
key_components.styling: Full-width card with gradient overlay (pink to rose), rounded corners (16px), height 180px, contains heading 'Fresh Flowers Delivered Today' and CTA button
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to featured collection or special offers

key_components.name: Category Pills
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list of pill-shaped buttons, white background with primary color border, padding 8px 16px, spacing 8px between items
key_components.interaction: Each pill filters catalog by category (Roses, Tulips, Mixed, Seasonal, Occasions)

key_components.name: Featured Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold heading 'Featured Arrangements' with 'See All' link on right, margin 24px 16px 12px
key_components.interaction: See All navigates to full featured catalog

key_components.name: Featured Flower Cards
key_components.styling: Grid of 2 columns, each card has rounded corners (12px), white background, shadow, product image at top (square aspect), flower name, price in bold, heart icon for wishlist
key_components.interaction: Tapping card navigates to flower detail screen, heart icon toggles wishlist

key_components.name: Popular Section Header
key_components.styling: Bold heading 'Popular This Week' with 'See All' link, margin 24px 16px 12px
key_components.interaction: See All navigates to popular catalog view

key_components.name: Popular Flower List
key_components.styling: Horizontal scrollable list, each item is a card (width 160px) with product image, name, price, rating stars
key_components.interaction: Tapping item navigates to flower detail screen

key_components.name: Quick Actions Section
key_components.styling: Two-column grid with icon cards: 'Same Day Delivery' and 'Gift Cards', each with icon, title, and subtitle, light background, rounded corners
key_components.interaction: Each card navigates to respective feature (delivery options or gift card purchase)

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, white background, shadow, 5 icons with labels: Home, Search, Cart (with badge), Orders, Profile, height 64px
key_components.interaction: Each icon navigates to respective screen, cart shows item count badge

screens.user_flow: Entry point of app. Users can browse categories, search, view featured flowers, or navigate to other sections via bottom nav. Tapping any flower card leads to detail screen.

screens.name: Flower Detail Screen
screens.purpose: Display comprehensive information about a specific flower arrangement including images, description, pricing, and purchase options

key_components.name: Top Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Transparent background overlaying image, back arrow on left, share and heart icons on right, height 56px
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen, share opens share sheet, heart toggles wishlist

key_components.name: Product Image Gallery
key_components.styling: Full-width carousel of product images, swipeable, page indicators at bottom, height 400px, rounded bottom corners (24px)
key_components.interaction: Swipe to view multiple product angles, tap to view fullscreen gallery

key_components.name: Product Title and Price
key_components.styling: Flower name in large bold heading font, price in primary color below, rating stars and review count, padding 20px
key_components.interaction: Static display, review count is tappable to view reviews

key_components.name: Availability Badge
key_components.styling: Small pill badge with success color background, text 'In Stock' or 'Limited Stock', positioned below price
key_components.interaction: Static indicator of stock status

key_components.name: Description Section
key_components.styling: White card with padding, heading 'About This Arrangement', body text with flower details, expandable if long, margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Expandable text with 'Read More' if content exceeds 3 lines

key_components.name: Delivery Options Card
key_components.styling: White card with icon, heading 'Delivery Options', list of delivery dates with radio buttons, same-day highlighted if available
key_components.interaction: Selecting date updates delivery date for order, opens date picker modal

key_components.name: Quantity Selector
key_components.styling: Horizontal control with minus button, quantity number, plus button, light border, rounded corners, centered in card
key_components.interaction: Plus/minus buttons increment/decrement quantity, updates price calculation

key_components.name: Add to Cart Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary color button, white text, rounded corners (12px), height 56px, text 'Add to Cart - $XX.XX', fixed at bottom with padding
key_components.interaction: Adds item to cart with selected quantity and delivery date, shows success animation, navigates to cart or shows confirmation

key_components.name: Similar Products Section
key_components.styling: Heading 'You May Also Like', horizontal scrollable list of product cards similar to home screen
key_components.interaction: Each card navigates to respective flower detail screen

key_components.name: Customer Reviews Preview
key_components.styling: White card with heading 'Customer Reviews', average rating, star display, preview of 2 recent reviews with user names and comments
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens full reviews screen with all customer feedback

screens.user_flow: Accessed from home screen or search results. Users view product details, select quantity and delivery date, then add to cart. Can navigate back to browse more or proceed to cart.

screens.name: Shopping Cart Screen
screens.purpose: Review selected items, modify quantities, view order summary, and proceed to checkout

key_components.name: Top Header Bar
key_components.styling: White background, back arrow on left, 'My Cart' title centered, trash icon on right for clear cart, height 60px, shadow
key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to previous screen, trash icon prompts confirmation to clear entire cart

key_components.name: Cart Items List
key_components.styling: Vertical list of cart item cards, each card has product thumbnail (80x80px), name, price, quantity selector, remove button, white background, dividers between items
key_components.interaction: Quantity selector updates item count and subtotal, remove button deletes item with confirmation, thumbnail navigates to product detail

key_components.name: Empty Cart State
key_components.styling: Centered illustration or icon, heading 'Your cart is empty', subtitle 'Add some beautiful flowers to get started', CTA button 'Browse Flowers'
key_components.interaction: CTA button navigates to home screen or catalog, shown only when cart has no items

key_components.name: Promo Code Input
key_components.styling: Input field with placeholder 'Enter promo code', apply button on right, light border, rounded corners, margin 16px
key_components.interaction: User enters code, tapping apply validates and applies discount, shows success or error message

key_components.name: Order Summary Card
key_components.styling: White card with subtle border, contains line items: Subtotal, Delivery Fee, Discount (if applied), Total in bold, padding 20px, margin 16px
key_components.interaction: Static display that updates when cart changes or promo applied

key_components.name: Delivery Date Selector
key_components.styling: Card with icon, label 'Delivery Date', selected date displayed, chevron right, tappable area
key_components.interaction: Opens date picker modal to select delivery date, updates all cart items

key_components.name: Special Instructions Input
key_components.styling: Multiline text area, placeholder 'Add delivery instructions (optional)', light border, rounded corners, max 200 characters
key_components.interaction: User can type special delivery notes, character count shown

key_components.name: Proceed to Checkout Button
key_components.styling: Full-width primary color button, white text, rounded corners (12px), height 56px, text 'Proceed to Checkout', fixed at bottom with safe area padding
key_components.interaction: Navigates to checkout screen with delivery and payment details, disabled if cart is empty

key_components.name: Continue Shopping Link
key_components.styling: Text link in secondary color, centered above checkout button, 'Continue Shopping'
key_components.interaction: Returns to home screen to browse more products

key_components.name: Saved Items Suggestion
key_components.styling: Small banner with heart icon, text 'You have 3 items in your wishlist', chevron right, light background
key_components.interaction: Tapping navigates to wishlist screen

screens.user_flow: Accessed from bottom nav or after adding items. Users review cart, adjust quantities, apply promos, select delivery date, then proceed to checkout. Can return to browse or continue to payment.

screens.name: Checkout Screen
screens.purpose: Collect delivery address, payment information, and finalize order placement

key_components.name: Top Header Bar

key_components.interaction: Back arrow returns to cart screen

key_components.name: Progress Indicator
key_components.styling: Horizontal stepper showing: 1. Delivery 2. Payment 3. Review, current step highlighted in primary color, completed steps with checkmark
key_components.interaction: Visual indicator only, not directly interactive

key_components.name: Delivery Address Card
key_components.styling: White card with heading 'Delivery Address', shows saved address if available, edit button, or form fields for new address (street, city, state, zip), rounded corners, padding 20px
key_components.interaction: Edit button allows modifying saved address, form fields are editable inputs, validates address format

key_components.name: Recipient Information Card

key_components.interaction: Input fields are editable, gift checkbox reveals gift message field when checked

key_components.name: Delivery Date and Time Card
key_components.styling: White card showing selected delivery date, time slot selector (Morning, Afternoon, Evening), calendar icon
key_components.interaction: Tapping opens date/time picker modal, updates delivery schedule

key_components.name: Payment Method Card
key_components.styling: White card with heading 'Payment Method', shows saved cards if available, add new card button, card input fields (number, expiry, CVV), secure badge
key_components.interaction: Selecting saved card uses it for payment, add new card reveals input fields, validates card details

key_components.name: Order Summary Collapsed
key_components.styling: Collapsible card showing total amount and item count, chevron to expand, light background
key_components.interaction: Tapping expands to show full order breakdown with item list and pricing details

key_components.name: Terms and Conditions Checkbox
key_components.styling: Checkbox with text 'I agree to terms and conditions', terms link in primary color, margin 16px

key_components.name: Place Order Button

key_components.name: Secure Payment Badge

key_components.interaction: Static trust indicator

screens.user_flow: Accessed from cart screen. Users enter or confirm delivery address, select payment method, review order, and place order. On success, navigates to order confirmation screen.

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar

key_components.name: Rewards Card

key_components.name: Bottom Navigation Bar
key_components.styling: Fixed bottom bar, white background, shadow, 5 icons with labels: Home, Search, Cart, Orders, Profile (highlighted), height 64px

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with screen sizes from 375px to 428px width. Components use flexible layouts with percentage-based widths and max-widths. Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Tablet layouts (768px+) utilize two-column grids for product cards and expanded side navigation. Desktop web (1024px+) shows three-column product grids with persistent side navigation and larger imagery. All layouts maintain consistent spacing scale (4px, 8px, 12px, 16px, 24px, 32px) and adapt typography sizes proportionally.
accessibility: WCAG 2.1 AA compliant with minimum 4.5:1 contrast ratio for text. All interactive elements have minimum 44x44px touch targets. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Form inputs include visible labels and error messages. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Color is not the only means of conveying information (icons and text accompany color-coded statuses). Images include alt text. Keyboard navigation supported for web version. Dynamic text sizing supported up to 200% without loss of functionality.
animations: Subtle, purposeful animations enhance usability without distraction. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (iOS-style push/pop). Button taps show 100ms scale down (0.95) with haptic feedback. Card taps show 150ms elevation increase. Loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect. Success actions show checkmark animation with scale and fade (500ms). Add to cart shows item flying to cart icon (400ms bezier curve). Pull-to-refresh uses native platform patterns. Modal appearances use slide-up with backdrop fade (250ms). All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon system using outlined style from Feather Icons or similar. Icons sized at 20px for inline use, 24px for navigation and headers, 16px for small contexts. Primary icons: home (house outline), search (magnifying glass), user (person outline), settings (gear), bell (notification), bookmark (ribbon), heart (outline/filled for wishlist), filter (funnel), plus (add), edit (pencil), trash (bin), share (arrow). All icons use currentColor for easy theming and maintain 2px stroke width for visual consistency.
